composition_note: Built from reports/channel_format_profile_portal.json (CFP-0004)'s 50-madde deep-dive of the 'Portal' channel. Unlike TPL-baskurtlar-hybrid and TPL-ryskulov-hybrid (which excluded 1-2 specific rules - K4, K9 - from an otherwise-adopted rule set), this template excludes a LARGER, more central portion of the source material: the source frames nihilism/depression as a superior-rational response rather than a condition, positions the channel as a substitute 'digital therapy room', and names building 'cult' devotion to an anonymous, infallible-seeming narrator as a scored success metric - all as the format's central thesis, not a peripheral rule. Only the source's legitimate CRAFT elements (hook structure, faceless-narrator audio/visual design, B-roll sync, philosophical curation technique, pacing/silence, dialectic narrative structure, measured closing) were adopted. See content_rules.rules_explicitly_not_adopted below for the excluded material and reasoning, and reports/channel_format_profile_portal.json's EDITORIAL FLAG for full detail.

forbidden: anything that could read as instructive/glorifying toward self-harm

music.instruments: ambient/lofi, reverb-heavy slowed piano, low synth pads - never rhythmic/epic, never vocals

narrator_persona.name: Sessiz Rehber (Silent Guide) - Portal tuning
narrator_persona.shared_with: TPL-mystery-discovery, TPL-boutique-intellectual (same archetype family per the source's own cross-channel analytical vocabulary, tuned differently here)
narrator_persona.voice_tone: Deliberately monotone/near-flat - the source names this explicitly as an intentional pacing device, not a delivery flaw. Slightly tired/melancholic register, never energetic or YouTuber-enthusiastic. Slows further, never speeds up, at emotionally heavy lines.
narrator_persona.word_choice: Complex philosophical concepts translated into everyday, concrete language (e.g. 'Amor Fati' rendered as embracing a missed bus or a boss's criticism) - never left as unexplained jargon.
narrator_persona.viewer_contract: Speaks as a fellow sufferer sharing an observation, never as a lecturer or a flawless authority. Uses 'we/us' language throughout ('Ortak Acıda Buluşma').
narrator_persona.context_discipline: Film/TV clips used ONLY to illustrate the argument, never allowed to become their own mini-review or plot summary (source's own rule: 'Ana Fikirden Sapmama'). A single visual metaphor set up at the opening is called back at points throughout for narrative unity, then resolved at the close.

content_rules.source: user-supplied 50-madde structural analysis of the 'Portal' channel, not Claude-authored - preserved here per Module 21's structural-only boundary (bible/Module_21_Channel_Format_Intelligence.md §2). A DELIBERATE, PARTIAL adoption - see rules_explicitly_not_adopted below, this is not the full rule set.
rules: P1 Pop-culture hook (Trojan Horse): open inside a well-known film/show scene or character crisis, not a summary - the audience arrives for a film analysis and receives a philosophical argument.

P2 Personal-life bridge: within the first minute, connect the on-screen character's pain to an ordinary, concrete detail of the viewer's own daily life (commute, job, screen time) - never left abstract.
P3 Faceless authority via voice+B-roll: no on-camera presenter - all authority is carried by narration voice, music, and film-clip/stock B-roll synced emotionally to the text.

P4 Concept-translation curation: name real thinkers/texts (Schopenhauer, Camus, Jung, etc.) but always translate their ideas into a concrete, applicable 'mental tool' for daily life - never leave a concept as unexplained jargon or a museum-piece history lesson.

P5 Grounded sociological critique: social commentary (consumer culture, social media validation-seeking, burnout) is always tied to a named thinker/text (Guy Debord, Byung-Chul Han), not free-floating opinion.
P6 Synchronized silence: a 3-4 second deliberate pause follows a heavy line, during which music and a single B-roll shot land together - this is a designed pacing beat, not a cutting error.
P7 Slow-content discipline: explicitly rejects algorithmic fast-cut/dopamine pacing in favor of a long-form, cinema-like viewing register.

P8 Dialectic structure: thesis (a popular belief/success narrative) -> antithesis (its philosophical critique) -> synthesis (a constructive, individual takeaway) - never left at pure critique without a synthesis beat.
P9 Narrative loop with metaphor callback: the opening scene/question is explicitly resolved at the close; a single visual metaphor set up early is referenced again at key points for cohesion.

P10 Measured closing, no algorithm CTA: ends on a philosophical line or quiet fade rather than a 'subscribe/like/bell' call-to-action; if any CTA exists, it is philosophically framed (an invitation to reflect/comment), never ad-copy.
rules_explicitly_not_adopted: Nihilism/depression framed as a superior-rational response rather than a condition (source Madde 32-33, 'Terapötik Etki (Acının Meşruiyeti)', 'Teselli Edici Nihilizm') - NOT adopted. A production made from this template may explore existentialist/absurdist ideas as PHILOSOPHY CONTENT, but must never imply that a viewer's depressive/nihilistic feelings are more rational or intelligent than the alternative, and must never substitute for encouraging real mental-health support when relevant.

'Digital therapy room' / 'Safe Space' self-positioning (Madde 35) - NOT adopted. This template's output is philosophy/culture commentary, not a substitute for therapy, and must not be marketed or framed as one.

Cult-building language: naming audience devotion a 'kült', elevating the anonymous narrator to a 'mitolojik, bilge gölge mentor' status 'arınmış dünyevi egolardan' (purified of earthly flaws) (Madde 41, 43, 45) - NOT adopted. The persona (narrator_persona above) is deliberately written as 'a fellow sufferer', not an infallible authority - facelessness is a production choice (P3), not a device for building unaccountable parasocial mystique.

Using real thinkers' documented suicides/institutionalization/mental illness as a 'yenilgi paydası' (shared-defeat bonding device) (Madde 34) - NOT adopted. Any factual biographical detail about a cited thinker must be handled with the same respect/accuracy standard as any other historical fact, never instrumentalized as a persuasion technique.

Monetization-through-parasocial-bond framing ('fanatikçe destekleyen bir patrona dönüştürüyor', Madde 44) - NOT adopted as a design goal; any support/membership mechanism, if used at all, should be a normal content-support option, not something engineered via the excluded techniques above.

editorial_note: This template has NOT been applied to any existing project in this repo. It adopts only the source channel's structural/craft elements (hook, pacing, visual/audio design, curation technique, narrative architecture) and explicitly excludes the source's nihilism-as-therapy framing and cult-building language - a larger and more central exclusion than the K4/K9 exclusions in TPL-baskurtlar-hybrid.json and TPL-ryskulov-hybrid.json, because in this source the excluded material is the format's stated central thesis, not a peripheral rule. Selecting and using this template for a specific project is a creative/editorial decision outside Technical Production Director authority (CLAUDE.md §3) and needs an explicit human choice, with particular attention to qa_overrides.sensitivity_review_required (set true here deliberately) given the subject matter's proximity to mental-health topics.
